Our Slender Blend is our best selling product and for good reason - it does exactly what it's supposed to do, and it does it whilst tasting delicious. And what is it that it's supposed to do? Well, It provides a high protein, low sugar, low calorie meal replacement option that will not only give you what you need nutritionally but will also satisfy any sweet cravings or need for a delicious treat because the Slender Blend tastes so good. When people are trying to lose weight or control their calories there are a couple of things that are really important to help them stay on track and reach their goals. 1) Keep protein intake high - this will ensure that you feel fuller and less hungry and that you retain as much muscle tissue as possible. 2) That you're able to adhere to some type of calorie controlled eating regimen. An important aspect of this one is enjoyment of what is consumed - does it taste good? So with an average of 24g of protein per serving our Slender Blend is definitely high in quality protein.
